summary: fix(settings): hide the locale and theme footer on pairing pages
description:
Because:

* The pairing pages are for mobile and must not show the locale and
  theme footer.

This commit:

* Adds a hideFooter prop to AppLayout in place of the unused
  showLocaleToggle prop.
* Passes hideFooter on every Pair2 and Pair/Unsupported page.

Closes FXA-14954
